description: This set is the HAWK-I cryogenic filter scans, including both K files and the NB0984 scan kept only in the Internet Archive. It is the same camera as Paranal/HAWKI, with NJM's band names.
facility_description: HAWK-I is the wide-field near-infrared imager on ESO's VLT at Paranal.
notes: NJM's Ks_2007 and Ks_2008 names are not in the ESO file headers. Those headers call both files a K filter scanned at 90 K. The 2007/2008 dates are therefore not taken from the scans. NB0984 is absent from the live directory and comes from the 2013 archive capture. No magnitude system is stated.

BrG.Comments: Same scan as ESO hawki_BrGamma.dat. Header: BrGamma filter curve at 90 K.

CH4.Comments: Same scan as ESO hawki_CH4.dat. Header: CH4 filter curve at 90 K.

H.Comments: Same scan as ESO hawki_H.dat. Header: H filter curve at 87 K, 'H 2 (S5-235-1)'.

H2.Comments: Same scan as ESO hawki_H2.dat. Header: H2 filter curve at 90 K.

J.Comments: Same scan as ESO hawki_J.dat. Header: J filter curve at 87 K.

Ks_2007.Comments: NJM points this band at ESO hawki_Kold.dat. That file's own header says 'K filter curve @ T=90K' and does not give a year.

Ks_2008.Comments: NJM points this band at ESO hawki_Knew.dat. That file's own header also says 'K filter curve @ T=90K' and does not give a year.

NB0984.Comments: Not in the current ESO filter directory. The curve NJM uses is the 23 June 2013 Internet Archive capture of hawki_NB0984.dat. Its header is only '#Wavelength %T(R)'.

NB1060.Comments: Same scan as ESO hawki_NB1060.dat. Header: NB1060 filter curve at 90 K.

NB1190.Comments: Same scan as ESO hawki_NB1190.dat. Header: NB1190 filter curve at 90 K.

NB2090.Comments: Same scan as ESO hawki_NB2090.dat. Header: NB2090 filter curve at 90 K.

Y.Comments: Same scan as ESO hawki_Y.dat. Header: Y filter curve at 87 K, 'Y 3 (Iz881,SN003)'.
